column1: # THE STUDIO NODE-CLASS ALLOWLIST. `studio.run_workflow` refuses any workflow
# whose `class_type` is not a row here (node_not_pinned), before anything is
#   package   `comfyui-core` (ships with the pinned ComfyUI, see
#             `name` of a [[node]] entry in custom-nodes.toml. A row whose
#             package is NOT pinned in custom-nodes.toml admits nothing: the
#             class is listed here ahead of its package so the pin (1956-bh6j)
#             lands without a second edit, but it does not run until then.
#   class     the ComfyUI class_type exactly as the API-format JSON spells it
# ---- 1956-bh6j: these packages are pinned in custom-nodes.toml (names match). ----
